+++ b/tests/test_regression_double_cancel.py
@@ -0,0 +1,19 @@
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from inventory_api import app as inventory
+from inventory_api.app import app
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+BOB = {"Authorization": "Bearer token-bob"}
+ALICE = {"Authorization": "Bearer token-alice"}
+
+def setup_function():
+    inventory.STOCK.update({"A-100": 100, "B-200": 20, "C-300": 3})
+    inventory.RESERVATIONS.clear()
+
+def test_double_cancel_rejected():
+    rid = client.post("/reservations", json={"sku": "C-300", "qty": 2}, headers=BOB).json()["id"]
+    assert client.delete(f"/reservations/{rid}", headers=BOB).status_code == 200
+    # second cancel of same reservation must not succeed / must not credit stock again
+    second = client.delete(f"/reservations/{rid}", headers=BOB)
+    assert second.status_code in (400, 404, 409), f"double cancel accepted: {second.status_code} {second.json()}"
+    assert client.get("/stock/C-300").json()["available"] == 3

@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from inventory_api import app as inventory
+from inventory_api.app import app
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+ALICE = {"Authorization": "Bearer token-alice"}
+BOB = {"Authorization": "Bearer token-bob"}
+
+def setup_function():
+    inventory.STOCK.update({"A-100": 100, "B-200": 20, "C-300": 3})
+    inventory.RESERVATIONS.clear()
+
+def test_negative_qty_rejected():
+    resp = client.post("/reservations", json={"sku": "A-100", "qty": -15}, headers=BOB)
+    # must be rejected, stock must never exceed warehouse count
+    assert resp.status_code in (400, 409, 422), f"negative qty accepted: {resp.status_code} {resp.json()}"
+    assert client.get("/stock/A-100").json()["available"] <= 100
